ModMetaData.name: Debug Assistance
ModMetaData.author: ilyvion
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a web-based Error Inspector and Hot Patch view for finding, understanding, and fixing mod errors without restarting the game.
Open the Error Inspector from a debug hotbar button or a browser to see a filterable, sortable list of captured errors with per-frame mod attribution, decompile any frame or Harmony patch on the spot with the crashing line highlighted, and save/load/delete sets of errors to a file.
The Hot Patch view lets you load a Harmony patch assembly you've built yourself, pick its Prefix/Postfix/Transpiler/Finalizer methods and a target method from any loaded mod, and apply or remove it live, without restarting the game. There is no sandboxing.
